init_3d_representation_voxel_grid: create a voxel grid 3D representation with random values and gradients enabled
init_3d_representation_triplane: create a triplane 3D representation with three orthogonal planes and gradients enabled
random_grid_voxel: create a random voxel grid tensor with specified size and gradient settings
grid_TV_loss: calculate total variation loss across a list of grid tensors with optional color grid
grid_L1_loss: calculate L1 regularization loss across a list of grid tensors with optional color grid
